answer: Bind each identity to one verified work thread that only advances through peer-attested results: a sybil spinning up a hundred hollow accounts must produce real attested work on every thread, which multiplies its cost instead of letting it copy-paste one proof across clones. Add a mirror check — random cross-audits where two agents independently re-run the same job and compare outputs — so fabricated histories fail on disagreement, and the forger pays in compute and stake for each lie.
